subject: english
chapter_title: The Thief's Story: Anil and Hari Singh

concepts.title: Hari Singh Meets Anil
concepts.definition: Hari Singh, a fifteen-year-old experienced thief, selects Anil, a thin, easy-going writer of twenty-five, as his next victim and charms his way into a job of cooking and household work.
concepts.key_idea: Anil, generous and trusting, lets the boy stay and even teaches him to write his name, promising to teach him to write whole sentences and add numbers.

solution_steps.explain: Hari changes his name monthly to stay free of police and reliable ex-employers, choosing his targets with care.

solution_steps.action: trace the entry into Anil's life
solution_steps.explain: He flatters Anil at the wrestling match and asks for work, cooking badly at first.
Anil laughs off the bad food, teaches him to cook, write his name and promises education worth more than wages.

concepts.title: The Theft of the Money
concepts.definition: One night, finding the bundle of notes under Anil's mattress, Hari Singh steals it and runs to the station, planning to catch the Lucknow Express, yet keeps hesitating at the thought of the education he would lose.
concepts.key_idea: The stolen six hundred rupees in fifties tempts him, but the memory of learning to write whole sentences pulls him back more strongly than fear.
question_patterns: how much money did hari singh steal and where was it kept

solution_steps.explain: The notes lay under the mattress on Anil's working night, and Hari slid them out.
He ran to the station with the money tucked into his waist, aiming for the Lucknow Express.
Education would bring more than a few hundred rupees, and the thought of Anil's sadness stayed his feet.

concepts.title: The Wet Notes and Anil's Silent Forgiveness
concepts.definition: Rain soaks the stolen notes, and Hari Singh creeps back to place them under the mattress; next morning Anil hands him a fifty-rupee note, saying it will be paid regularly, showing that he knew of the theft and forgave it.
concepts.key_idea: Anil's quiet understanding, not punishment, reforms the thief, and Hari realizes that Anil knew everything yet chose kindness.

solution_steps.explain: Standing in the rain drenched the currency, making it wet and difficult to use.
Hari crept in, placed the wet notes back under the mattress, and set out to make the tea.
The still damp fifty-rupee note in Anil's hand showed he knew, yet he spoke only of regular payment.

concepts.title: Trust and Transformation in the Story
concepts.definition: The story shows that trust can reform a wrongdoer: Anil's complete trust, his patience and his gift of education slowly turn a thief away from crime toward honest living.
concepts.key_idea: Hari Singh's real victory is over his own thieving habits, won by the moral power of a man who forgave without a word of blame.
question_patterns: what role does trust play in changing hari singh

solution_steps.explain: Anil houses, feeds and educates the boy without asking for proof of honesty.
The chance to steal meets the chance to learn, and the boy chooses learning.
Hari's smile at the end signals hope that he will use the last chance Anil has given him.
